| Observation | Filing date | Period label | Basis | Records |

The sequence is monotonic and each release follows its period close. AMD-03 is a **dual-period release** — the decisive structural hazard for this task. The required comparisons are quarterly (Q3 2024 → Q4 2024), so only the Q4 2024 quarterly column is used; FY2024 annual figures are excluded from both formulas.

Directional sequence (GAAP quarterly, as labeled): revenue "$5,835" → "$6,819" → "$7,658" ($M) [REC-AMD-01-01, REC-AMD-02-01, REC-AMD-03-01]; gross margin "49%" → "50%" → "51%" [same records]. - Q4 2024 segment sequential detail is not stated in the excerpts (Y/Y only) [REC-AMD-03-03]; one specialist flagged the Data Center quarterly figure as partially truncated and did not rely on it.

**Audit status:** both results are consistent with the issuer's own rounded Q/Q disclosures ("Up 12%", "Up 1%") [REC-AMD-03-01]. **Downside evidence and contradictions (facts, not judgments):**
- **Earnings divergence:** Q4 2024 GAAP net income "$482" ($M), "Down 28%" Y/Y and "Down 37%" Q/Q; diluted EPS "$0.29", "Down 29%" Y/Y and "Down 38%" Q/Q [REC-AMD-03-01] — while operating income rose to "$871" ($M) and revenue set a record. - **Growth deceleration:** sequential revenue growth slowed from the Q3 Q/Q pace reported as "Up 17%" [REC-AMD-02-01] to the computed +12.3% in Q4, while remaining positive.
- **Basis sensitivity:** non-GAAP Q4 gross margin "54%" [REC-AMD-03-02] differs materially from GAAP 51%; conclusions drawn on one basis do not transfer to the other.

**Governance:** source facts (§2), derived calculations (§3), and the policy-driven state judgment below are kept strictly separate. No investment recommendation is made and **no trade is authorized**.

**Policy-driven state judgment (not SEC evidence).** The bounded transition rule for FSEC-AMD-03 requires that the required source metrics and both calculations be verified. All four metrics are cited to GAAP quarterly records [REC-AMD-02-01, REC-AMD-03-01], and both calculations were independently reproduced and cross-checked against the issuer's own disclosures [REC-AMD-03-01]. |---|---|

| status | **active** |

This is a state-transition record, not a recommendation.

---

- **Excerpt-bounded corpus.** Only the supplied record excerpts were used; full filings, reconciliations, and MD&A explanations were not available. The cause of the Q4 net-income decline is unexplained within the evidence.
- **No segment-to-consolidated reconciliation** is present in the excerpts; no segment arithmetic is asserted.
- **Presentation inconsistencies remain open:** the "Up 1%" vs percentage-point label [REC-AMD-03-01] and the "$7.7 billion" narrative vs "$7,658" table value [REC-AMD-03-01, REC-AMD-03-02].
- **Truncated text:** at least one segment figure (Q4 Data Center quarterly revenue) is partially illegible in the excerpt [REC-AMD-03-03] and was not relied upon.
- **Basis scope:** only GAAP quarterly figures were used; non-GAAP results differ materially and were deliberately excluded.
- **Out-of-scope issuers:** Intel and NVIDIA records were present in the corpus but are not comparable to AMD's periods and were excluded from all analysis.
- **No forward-looking inference, valuation, recommendation, or trade authorization** is made; the state transition reflects only the supplied policy applied to verified evidence.
